title: Lightpath Technologies Inc Institutional Investor Sentiment Worsened in Q3 2018
text:
Posted by Linda Rogers 11:03 am Sentiment for Lightpath Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:LPTH)
Lightpath Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:LPTH) institutional sentiment decreased to 1.71 in 2018 Q3 . Its down -0.09, from 1.8 in 2018Q2. The ratio has dropped, as 12 investment managers opened new or increased positions, while 7 decreased and sold their positions in Lightpath Technologies Inc. The investment managers in our partner’s database now have: 6.81 million shares, down from 7.12 million shares in 2018Q2. Also, the number of investment managers holding Lightpath Technologies Inc in their top 10 positions was flat from 0 to 0 for the same number . Sold All: 1 Reduced: 6 Increased: 7 New Position: 5.
LightPath Technologies, Inc. designs, develops, makes, and distributes optical components and assemblies. The company has market cap of $36.10 million. The firm offers precision molded glass aspheric optics, molded and diamond-turned infrared aspheric lenses, GRADIUM glass lenses, and other optical materials used to produce products that manipulate light. It has a 140 P/E ratio. The Company’s products are used in various industries, including defense products, medical devices, laser aided industrial tools, automotive safety applications, barcode scanners, optical data storage, hybrid fiber coax datacom, telecommunications, machine vision and sensors, and other industries.
The stock decreased 2.78% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $1.4. About 69,925 shares traded. LightPath Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ:LPTH) has declined 31.62% since December 24, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 31.62% the S&P500.
Manatuck Hill Partners Llc holds 0.79% of its portfolio in LightPath Technologies, Inc. for 1.05 million shares. Thompson Davis & Co. Inc. owns 37,415 shares or 0.16% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Vertex One Asset Management Inc. has 0.12% invested in the company for 374,938 shares. The New York-based Penbrook Management Llc has invested 0.11% in the stock. First Interstate Bank, a Montana-based fund reported 36,000 shares.
